task: EPMCDME-8561 — make the Data Sources file dropzone live region name added and removed files (WCAG SC 4.1.3) via a pure message builder and a multiset diff over file names.

key_reasoning.reason: Announcement correctness depends on the existing useAnnouncementQueue timing (messages play about a second apart), so several files added at once had to be aggregated into one message instead of one per file. The multiset diff also has to treat same-name replacements as a real change. Extracting buildFileAnnouncements as a pure function kept the risk contained and fully unit-testable; base score S (2) bumped to M (3) by the accessibility-conformance red flag.

4 files changed, 202 insertions / 13 deletions, all inside src/components/form/FilesDropzone/: FilesDropzone.tsx modified, announcements.ts added, plus the two matching test files. Two of the four are new, and both new files are tests-or-pure-logic with no cross-directory reach.

Single presentational component plus one new sibling helper module. No shared utility, store, API client, or route touched; the component's public props are unchanged, so no caller in Data Sources or elsewhere needed edits.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from S (2) to M (3): the change exists to satisfy a WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.3 accessibility-compliance requirement, which the guide treats as a compliance red flag.
